summary.prose: Building this story means creating the project's first real code: a small set of one-responsibility packages for records, embedding, composition, scoring, probe loading, orchestration, reporting and the command line, all testable offline with a fake embedder. It ends with a draft probe set of 100 operations and 300 queries for the user to review. No pass or fail verdict exists until that review happens and the run is made against the local model.

tasks.title: Domain records and package foundation
tasks.summary: Add numpy through uv, remove the hello stub, ignore the runs directory, add the domain package with the modality and phase table, split, ProbeOperation, ProbeQuery, ProbeSet (records, reviewed flag, file hashes), MethodVariant, QueryTrack and PassCriterion, and add the import-direction test that encodes the allowed dependency table.
acceptanceChecks: numpy is the only new runtime dependency and uv.lock is updated
The hello stub is gone and the import test passes
runs/ is in the ignore list
domain imports nothing from the project
The import-direction test fails on any import outside the LLD table, including a deliberately forbidden example it is checked against
The phase table gives +1, +2, +1, -1, -1 for required, strict_required, permitted, not_required, prohibited
An operation is identified by concept and modality, never by phase or concept alone

tests.name: import direction between packages follows the allowed table and rejects a forbidden example
modality phase table and operation identity by concept and modality

tasks.title: Embeddings protocol, errors and disk cache
tasks.summary: Add the Embedder protocol and the EncoderFingerprint record in embeddings/protocol.py, EmbeddingBackendError, a disk cache wrapper keyed by fingerprint and text with atomic writes and read validation, and a deterministic fake embedder for tests. The fingerprint lives here because embeddings may import no other project package.
acceptanceChecks: The fingerprint holds model name, digest, quantization, backend name and version, dimension, text convention and dtype
Cache key changes when digest, dimension, text convention or text changes
A corrupt or truncated entry is discarded and encoded again
Entries are written through a temporary file and atomic rename
Empty or whitespace input raises ValueError
Duplicate inputs return identical rows in input order
embeddings imports no other project package

tests.name: cache key changes with digest, dimension, convention and text; corrupt entry recovery
empty input rejection and duplicate inputs in order

tasks.title: Ollama backend
tasks.summary: Add the Ollama embedder in embeddings/ollama.py using the standard library HTTP client: loopback-only base URL, local model list and digest check before encoding, batches of at most 32, and response checks for count, shape, finiteness and norm. Add the live contract test for dimensions 256, 512 and 1024.
acceptanceChecks: Stubbed-transport tests cover batching, order, bad responses, digest mismatch and a non-loopback URL
An unreachable server, an error status and a model missing from the local list each raise EmbeddingBackendError naming the endpoint and model
No partial result is returned and nothing from a bad batch is cached
Live test passes against qwen3-embedding:0.6b at all three dimensions and is skipped with a stated reason when Ollama is unavailable
No module outside embeddings/ollama.py holds Ollama knowledge apart from the command line constructing it

tests.name: Ollama backend against a stubbed transport: batching, order, bad responses, digest mismatch, non-loopback URL
absence of Ollama knowledge outside embeddings/ollama.py
dimensions 256, 512 and 1024 return unit vectors in input order

tasks.title: Composition
tasks.summary: Add rendering that builds the stored and symmetric-query texts for each method from domain records, and pure vector arithmetic for C0, C1, C2, C4 and C5 with normalization and zero-norm rejection.
acceptanceChecks: Formulas match the LLD for every method and weight
C2 at weight 1.0 equals C0
A norm at or below 1e-12 raises ValueError naming the method and weight
Symmetric query composition never uses the expected modality or phase, and the C4 query text has no Phase field
No negated vector is used
composition imports only domain and reads no files and calls no model

tests.name: composition formulas, C2 at 1.0 equals C0, zero-norm rejection
symmetric query composition never uses the expected modality or phase

tasks.title: Evaluation
tasks.summary: Add the CollapseResult types and pure functions for modality ranking with ties, the 5x5 confusion matrix with a tie column, pairwise accuracy, margins and worst cases, the neutral top-five share, variant selection on the select split and the verdict on the confirm split.
acceptanceChecks: Scores within 1e-6 count as a tie and a wrong answer
Accuracy, confusion, the ten pairwise accuracies, margins and neutral share match hand-computed examples
A split with no queries for a modality pair is an error, never a perfect score
Selection order is accuracy, worst pair, smallest dimension, then method id and weight, using only select results
The verdict uses only the chosen variant on confirm results against 0.95 and 0.90 on the natural track
evaluation imports only domain

tests.name: ranking, ties, confusion matrix, pairwise accuracy, margins, neutral share
variant selection tie-break and confirm-split verdict

tasks.title: Probe loading and validation
tasks.summary: Add the probes package that loads operations.jsonl, queries.jsonl and manifest.json into a domain ProbeSet and validates fields, unique ids, five modalities per concept, phase table, split per concept, queries for every modality pair in each split, query text distinct from stored text and manifest hashes, reporting every failure together.
acceptanceChecks: Each validation failure has a test using a small synthetic probe set
A split lacking queries for any modality pair is rejected
All failures are listed in one error
The reviewed_by_user flag is returned to the caller
probes imports only domain and reads nothing from the benchmark archive

tests.name: probe loading and each validation failure

tasks.title: Experiment orchestration
tasks.summary: Add the run config holding the pass criterion, variants, weights and dimensions, and the collapse run that takes a ProbeSet and injected embedders, composes both tracks, evaluates both splits, checks the C5 control, applies draft or verdict rules and returns a run result carrying the config and encoder fingerprints.
acceptanceChecks: The criterion is fixed in the config before the first encode call and is unchanged in the run result
C5 results that are not all ties fail the run as a harness error
An unreviewed probe set runs only with the draft option and yields no verdict
C2 at 1.0 is computed once and C3 is reported as identical to C1
Natural and symmetric results are never mixed
experiments uses only the embedder protocol from embeddings and does not import probes or reporting

tasks.title: Reporting and command line
tasks.summary: Add the run record and Markdown report writers under runs/ and the command line that loads the probes, builds the cache and Ollama embedders, opens the run through reporting so the directory, criterion and config are written first, runs the experiment, then writes the results. Add a project script entry point.
acceptanceChecks: An offline end-to-end test with the fake embedder writes the run record and report
An existing run directory stops the command before any embedding and is not overwritten
The criterion appears in the run record before any embedding happens
A draft report is labelled draft and states no verdict
Backend and validation errors end the command with a clear message and no verdict
The command line holds wiring only and reporting does not import embeddings

tests.name: collapse run writes run record and report
existing run directory is not overwritten
criterion is recorded before embedding and errors end with no verdict

tasks.title: Probe concepts and stored operations
tasks.summary: Author data/probes/modality_collapse_v1/operations.jsonl with 20 operation concepts, all five modalities each, and 10 select and 10 confirm concepts.
acceptanceChecks: 100 operations, one per concept and modality, with phases matching the table
10 select and 10 confirm concepts, assigned before any run
No concept used in the earlier preliminary modality probe is in the confirm split
The benchmark archive is not opened while authoring

tests.name: committed probe operations have 100 records, five modalities per concept and a 10 and 10 split

tasks.title: Draft queries and manifest for user review
tasks.summary: Author queries.jsonl with three natural paraphrases per concept and modality (300 queries) and a synonym term each, the manifest with reviewed_by_user false, and a separate list of ambiguous wording for the user to decide.
acceptanceChecks: The set passes validation with 100 operations and 300 queries split 10 and 10 by concept
The manifest has reviewed_by_user false and only the user's explicit review changes it
Words that fit more than one modality are excluded or listed for the user to assign
No query copies a stored text, and the benchmark archive is not opened while authoring
No embedding result is used to write or edit a query

tests.name: committed probe set passes validation with 300 queries
